description: Turn a verified full close (closeId from gdex_replay_trade) or a packaged scenario (scenarioId) into a practice challenge another agent can play. First call returns a PREVIEW of the exact message: show it to the user. Only after they confirm, call again with confirmExport: true and the exportToken. The capsule names a synthetic practice scenario; it never contains wallet/account ids, balances, size, fills, order ids, exact times or P&L. Nothing is sent anywhere; the user copies the message.

confirmExport.description: True only after the user approved the previewed message

includeInvite.description: Add the user's existing GDEX invite link, with a disclosure. Off by default; only if the user asks.

includeSenderPlan.description: Add the trade's TP/SL distances (rounded %) as the plan to compare against. Off by default.

name: gdex_make_challenge
